_comment: Balanced set of PUBLIC Telegram web-preview channels (https://t.me/s/<name>) tracking the Sudan war. lean = editorial side, NOT ground truth. Chosen for a balanced pro-SAF / pro-RSF / neutral mix, then verified: only channels whose /s/ web preview actually serves dated messages are kept (many Sudan-war handles disable the preview -> a 'Contact @x' page, or are stale/sold). Scraped from public previews only (no API, no login). Leans sourced from IFRI 'Sudan Wartime Online Propaganda' (2026), channel self-description and observed framing. NOTE: the pro-RSF public /s/ presence with geolocatable tactical content is structurally thin beyond the official account (most handles are preview-disabled or stale); the pro-SAF ecosystem lives mostly off Telegram (Facebook/X/YouTube/TV). SudanTribune was dropped in v2: its handle now reads 'username for sale' (abandoned).
